role: Prospective complete-learning development, not confirmation or manuscript evidence
baseline_selection: Per task strongest development mean native-transition return AUC among all seven non-recycle controls; preserve every method, seed and task
resource_scope: Exactly 16000 training joint transitions and 4800 independent evaluation joint transitions per cell. All ten methods pay all native episodes, actor/critic/proposal/hint/score/potential work, logical tensor bytes and messages. No refund of rejected or terminal in-flight gradients. Soft Lyapunov operating points constrain prospective broadcasts and extra score forwards; no measured network speedup claim.
precision_and_runtime: No qualification outcome was inspected. Qualification CPU timing, not return, selects 32 independent paired-seed evaluation episodes at frames 0,8,16,24,32,40 for a bounded development screen. This is not inferential confirmation; positive development requires fresh multi-seed confirmation with separately frozen precision. The whole sequential science/replay workflow has a 12000 active CPU second bound.
decision: Primary: both task return-AUC gains against strongest registered baseline at least 1%, positive in at least two of three seeds, final return noninferior within 2%, actual baseline learning and nonzero version staleness. Always report communication AUC, full work bills and both ablations. Pass permits only a separate confirmation/design decision; no GPU or manuscript claims automatically.
stop: Any payload or mandatory scientific gate failure preserves complete evidence and stops this frozen study without retries, task removal, seed changes or threshold relaxation. Diagnose the full algorithm mechanism before any new substantive design.
